name: robots/mortezaaliyari__multi-robot-gazebo-navistack
title: Multi-robot TurtleBot3 Gazebo/Nav stack
intro: Multi-robot TurtleBot3 Gazebo/Nav stack, adapted from mortezaaliyari/multi-robot-gazebo-navistack. It reads `read_tb3_0_odom`, `read_tb3_0_scan`, `read_tb3_1_odom` and `read_tb3_1_scan`; runs `publish_tb30_cmd_vel`, `publish_tb31_cmd_vel` and `resume_simulation`. `publish_tb30_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to the tb3_0 Gazebo cmd_vel topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
